messages:
Ravi: Hi team, first-day onboarding snag. I'm deploying a small pubsub + Cloud Function in project `redwood-sandbox` using CMEK (key: projects/redwood-keys/locations/global/keyRings/redwood-onboard/cryptoKeys/deploy-key). Terraform fails with `Permission denied` on the KMS key. Also I can't see Billing in the console; it says project not linked. Who can grant the key permission and/or link billing?
Marta (cloud infra): Welcome! For CMEK you need `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on that cryptoKey for the SA running Terraform. Which SA are you using? For billing, we file a billing request to link the project to the org billing account.
Ravi: SA is `deployer@redwood-sandbox.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Terraform runs with that. I can paste the tf plan if helpful.
Priya (security): Also check org policy restricting CMEK key usage to prod-only key rings. Try `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy deploy-key --keyring=redwood-onboard --location=global --project=redwood-keys` to confirm. If org policy blocks, we need an exception.
Marta (cloud infra): I can grant the KMS role to the SA for a short window. DM me the project id, SA email, reason (onboarding), and duration. For billing linking: open a ticket to billing@redwood with project id and request to link to `ORG-BILL-001`. Cloud Tools Bot will create the ticket.
Cloud Tools Bot: Ticket BILL-2026-45 created: Link project `redwood-sandbox` to org billing account ORG-BILL-001. Assignee: Jamal (finance). ETA: 1 business day.
Ravi: DM sent with justification and plan gist. Thanks everyone, will wait for billing + temporary KMS role before re-running terraform.
